risks.risk: The engine may be a used or rebuilt unit with internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and a photo of the engine identification plate.
risks.if_unproven: as a used engine requiring a rebuild

risks.risk: The engine may be missing a critical component (e.g., water pump, oil pump).
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with all components visible.

Photo of the engine with all components visible.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
